Nuxt compared `routeRules` keys against the raw request path, without decoding percent-encoding, while the router decodes parameters when it resolves a route. A request whose path is percent-encoded can therefore resolve to a page while failing to match the route rule meant to protect it, so the rule's `appMiddleware` never runs, including during server rendering.

`toml.parse()` converts integer literals (hex, octal, binary, and decimal) to `BigInt` without first bounding the length of the digit sequence. exception and reports success, the database row survives, and the token keeps authenticating. Any
application, admin integration or operational script that revokes credentials by calling `.delete()`
on a `TokenProxy` instance believes it has revoked a token that is still live.
